transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I've just been feeling really down and sad all the time, and I can't seem to shake it. This depressed mood has been going on constantly for about two years and two months now. I just feel completely exhausted by it.
Have you also had any periods of at least two months during this time when your mood felt back to normal?

I'm not quite sure, to be honest. I haven't really thought about whether there were clear two-month periods where I felt completely back to normal. It just feels like this heavy feeling has been there the whole time.

During the past two years, has there been any period of at least two weeks when your mood was especially worse than usual, with symptoms like loss of interest, sleep or appetite changes, or feeling worthless?

Honestly, my low mood and feelings of worthlessness have just been mostly constant and steady over the last two years. I'm not really sure if there was a specific two-week period where it got significantly worse than usual. I also haven't really noticed any specific changes in my sleep or appetite.
Have you ever had a stretch of at least two months during these two years when you felt much better or back to your usual self?

No, I haven't had any break or stretch of two months where I felt better. These feelings of sadness, emptiness, and low self-worth have been completely continuous and constant over the entire two years and two months.

Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks during this time when you had several symptoms of major depression, such as loss of interest, major sleep or appetite changes, poor concentration, or thoughts that life wasn’t worth living?

No, I haven't really experienced those specific symptoms like major sleep or appetite changes, poor concentration, or thoughts of life not being worth living. Instead, it has just been a constant, lingering sadness and emptiness for over two years now.

Thank you. Based on what you’ve told me, this sounds most consistent with persistent depressive disorder; I’d like to ask one more thing: have you ever had any manic or hypomanic episodes, such as periods of unusually high energy, decreased need for sleep, or feeling overly confident?
No, I have never experienced anything like that. I've never had periods of unusually high energy, a decreased need for sleep, or feeling overly confident.
